scope.weight_layout: packed G16,U16 with PI16 inside each block
scope.INT8_path: INT8 A/W -> INT32 accumulation -> (sx*sw)*float(acc) -> BF16 RNE in registers -> FP32 SiLU*up -> BF16 RNE store
scope.BF16_path: BF16 A/W -> FP32 accumulation -> BF16 RNE in registers -> FP32 SiLU*up -> BF16 RNE store

method.aggregation: median of seven rounds per seed, then median of three held-out seed medians
method.main_baseline: lower aggregate median of frozen GEMM+AITER and frozen GEMM+single-kernel Triton
method.same_tile_control: same packed G16/U16 W, same family and K loop; materialize BF16 gate_up, then standalone Triton SiLU*up
method.timed_scope: A pack + GEMM + activation/BF16 output. Static weight/scale preparation excluded; input INT8 quantization excluded.

environment.device: _CudaDeviceProperties(name='BW1000 64G', major=9, minor=3, gcnArchName='gfx936:sramecc+:xnack-', total_memory=65520MB, multi_processor_count=80, uuid=30303135-3338-6139-6634-653434313031, pci_bus_id=193, pci_device_id=0, pci_domain_id=0, L2_cache_size=8MB)
environment.activation: AITER silu_and_mul(out,input,limit=0) and single-kernel Triton sigmoid(g)*g*u, FP32 arithmetic
environment.scope: A pack + GEMM + activation/BF16 output. Static weight/scale preparation excluded; input INT8 quantization excluded.

instruction_resource_audit.SwiGLU: v_exp_f32 + v_rcp_f32 in register; BF16 RNE before SiLU and on final output

policy.selection: Small M nearest measured point; M129+ upper 16-row endpoint. Minimum measured fused latency among legal tiles. BF16 E030 excluded because split-K changes intermediate BF16 rounding relative to current baseline.
